text: RESULTS: Normal Readings for Maternal History; Chest X-Ray shows ground-glass appearance and air bronchograms suggestive of Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS).

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS).

The chest X-ray showing ground-glass appearance and air bronchograms is highly characteristic of RDS, a condition caused by surfactant deficiency in premature infants. Given the normal Apgar scores and birth weight, the severity is likely mild to moderate. I will now monitor oxygen saturation levels to guide treatment.
